description: Hiring radar, the dataset Sales Legends keeps on sales hiring for investors and analysts: each sales opening read from employers' careers boards since the board started, a row per role with its posted pay, kind, countries and the days it opened and closed, with every employer day by day and a change log. The answer gives today's coverage, the files, who they are for, the price and how to request a sample. Call it only for someone buying or evaluating the full history. Today's counts come from get_sales_market and single roles from search_sales_jobs.
name: get_hiring_radar
title: Sales hiring data for investors
